title: AgitAgueda
mainIdea: Portugal's festivals allow visitors to experience the country's vibrant culture, traditions, and famous attractions.

pages.text: Many visitors travel to Portugal to experience AgitAgueda and its exciting celebrations.

question.text: Who are the main subjects in the story?

pages.text: Visitors wanted to enjoy the music, art, food, and culture during the festival.

options: To buy a new house near the festival streets
To enjoy Portugal's festivals and culture
To build umbrellas for the Umbrella Sky Project

pages.text: Portugal has many festivals and attractions, giving visitors many places and events to explore.

question.text: What challenge did the visitors face?
options: They had nothing at all to see in the whole country of Portugal.
They had many festivals and attractions to explore.
They could not enter Portugal during the festival season.

pages.text: They attended AgitAgueda, visited the Umbrella Sky Project, explored local landmarks, and learned about other festivals.

question.text: How did the visitors experience Portugal's culture?
options: By staying inside their hotel for the whole festival week
By attending festivals and visiting famous attractions
By avoiding local traditions and eating only familiar food

pages.text: The visitors enjoyed Portugal's colorful festivals and discovered the country's rich traditions.

options: The visitors left the country without learning anything at all.
The visitors experienced Portugal's festivals and culture.
